name: Auntie Ashley
description: Rooted in the rich culinary heritage of Ipoh, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam brings the true taste of Malaysia’s most celebrated food town to the heart of Orchard, The Centrepoint. Inspired by the success of Choy Kee Bakery in Ipoh, this new outlet continues the same dedication to authenticity, tradition, and comfort food that generations have grown up loving. Every dish served is a tribute to Ipoh’s time-honoured kopitiam culture, where simple ingredients are elevated through craftsmanship, patience, and recipes passed down through generations. At the heart of the menu is our signature Nasi Ayam Goreng Berempah, marinated with over ten aromatic Malay spices and fried to golden perfection—crispy on the outside, juicy within, and deeply fragrant. Our Ipoh Hor Fun is another standout, made using rice noodles renowned for their silky smooth texture, a hallmark of Ipoh’s mineral-rich spring water. Served in comforting chicken broth or bold curry, each bowl delivers warmth, depth, and unmistakable authenticity. Complementing the mains are classic sides like Hainanese Chicken Chop Rice, Sizzling Hot Plate Claypot Noodles, and freshly prepared dim sum that recall the bustling kopitiams of old Ipoh. No Ipoh experience is complete without coffee. Our authentic Ipoh Chang Jiang White Coffee, roasted with butter for a smoother, richer aroma, stays true to the original Ipoh method, offering a nostalgic cup that pairs perfectly with Choy Kee Egg Tarts. From hearty rice dishes to nostalgic desserts and handcrafted drinks, Auntie Ashley Kopitiam is more than a meal — it is a comforting journey home, familiar yet exciting, for those who are seeking genuine Ipoh flavours in Singapore.

description: Bae.Gal is a brand-new concept by Swee Heng Bakery. Specializing in Asian-style bagels with a soft and chewy texture with our homegrown roots, Bae.Gal seeks to bring more excitement to the world of confectionery. description: Baker’s Brew is Singapore’s leading cake specialist serving the most beautiful and decadent cakes, one-of-a-kind pastries and cookies, perfect for both of life's little moments and big milestones.

name: Bali Thai
description: At Bali Thai, we bring you the best of both Thai and Indonesian cuisines. We want you to relish, experience, and enjoy this perfect fusion at affordable prices. Each Bali Thai restaurant boasts unique interior décor, blending contemporary style with traditional elements to offer a modern yet exotic dining experience. Perfect for family celebrations or casual business meals, Bali Thai consistently delights customers with delicious, affordable dishes. Our Halal certification also makes us a popular choice within the Muslim community. Some of the all-time favourites at Bali Thai include Tahu Telur - a must try typical Indonesian appetiser. This simple beancurd dish is fried with crispy egg fluffs coated on the outside and smooth eff residues on the inside. The specially prepared sweet peanut sauce that comes with it adds the extra oomph to the taste. For seafood lovers, opt for our popular Combi Bakar, which is a combo platter of mixed barbecue items, - fish, prawn, cuttlefish, chicken and satay. And what is Thai food without tasting the authentic, traditional Thai Green Curries? Diners will drool over a choice of our tender Chicken or Beef slices cooked in spicy hot curries, served together with fragrant steamed rice. For the best Thai soup, nothing beats the sour spicy Tom Yum Goong or Talay, which is best known among the Thais as their proud signature dish. It is flavourful and always unforgettable.

name: Bari Bari Steak
description: A concept from Hong Kong that celebrates the art of teppan cuisine. We specialise in premium Japanese steak cuts, alongside carefully selected cuts from other regions, all expertly seared on an iron griddle and served with a hot stone steak pellet made from high-density stone from Japan, heated up to 300°C, allowing you to continue searing your steak to your preferred doneness. Our steaks are served at a perfect medium rare, with specially curated Japanese donburi selections, sides and kids meals included. All teppan dishes come with complimentary free-flow Japanese salad bar, featuring a generous spread of fresh greens, sides, carbs and dessert.

name: Beard Papa’s
description: Since 1999, Beard Papa’s has been baking The World’s Best Cream Puffs. They began in Japan and have expanded to 430+ stores in the world; committed to serving pastries that are super oishii! (delicious!). Beard papa’s signature custard cream is made only from fresh and natural ingredients. You can smell the aroma of genuine vanilla bean, one of the most valuable spices on the planet and the richness of luxurious whipping cream and butter.

name: Beauty in The Pot
description: Savour the essence of health & beauty from our ten nourishing soup bases, which includes the all-time favourite Beauty Collagen Broth, Spicy Nourishing Broth and exclusive private room new soup selections. Every steaming pot of broth is prepared using an array of quality ingredients specially selected for a divine experience.

name: Bee Cheng Hiang
description: Bee Cheng Hiang has been passionately committed to making the best bakkwa since 1933. The home-grown brand uses the most natural and premium ingredients possible and maintains an unyielding position on rejecting the use of MSG, artificial preservatives, meat-tenderiser, colouring and flavouring. Known for its enterprising and innovative spirit, Bee Cheng Hiang has pioneered various products that have redefined the bakkwa industry, such as the Mini EZ Series (vacuum-packed bakkwa) and the EZ Mini Crunchies series (crunchy floss). Today, with more than 370 stores in 12 countries and regions, Bee Cheng Hiang is the largest bakkwa retailer globally.

name: Bengawan Solo
description: Bengawan Solo was founded in 1979 by Tjendri Anastasia, originally from Indonesia. Anastasia came to Singapore where she met her husband, Johnson Liew. After getting married, Anastasia's interest in Indonesian delicacies continued in the little home kitchen of her HDB flat. Gradually, word of her tasty goodies got around and before she knew it, orders for her cakes and kueh came rolling in. Her home-made specialties even made it onto the shelves of supermarkets and emporiums, albeit produced without a food manufacturing licence.

description: Beutea - a modern tea beverage brand using "Freshly Brewed Chinese Tea" (a combination of ancient Chinese and modern tea beverage). Beutea practices the four ancient tea ceremony skills “moisten”, “soak”, “boil”, and “brew” using extract from the finest hand-picked tea leaves originating from tea mountains of Yunnan and Wuyi in China as the base of their beverages. It is then blended with modern flavours such as fresh milk and fresh fruits to brew unique, exquisite, aromatic and delicious fresh tea beverages. “A sip of tea lingers, two sips come with a long aftertaste” serves as the purpose of founding the brand as they aspire to be the top unique and delicious fresh tea beverage brand.

name: Chinatown Tan's TuTu Coconut Cake
description: The original Kueh Tutu was called “san” or light cake which came in the form of a large cake of rice flour without any filling and was steamed in trays. The kuehs consist of ground roasted peanuts or grated coconut with brown palm sugar fillings and this is unique to Singapore. The late Mr Tan Tuan Chiang learned about Kueh Tutu when he joined his father’s trade more than 50 years ago. The Tans’ push-carts were familiar sights in Chinatown then. To ensure that he prepares the perfect old-style Tutu Kuehs, he pounds whole rice grains to make rice flour. The purity of whole rice grains ensures that his cake is pure white. The flour is sifted many times so that the cakes are truly “san” or light. Finally the cake is filled and steamed before being served on a piece of fragrant pandan leaf. Handcrafted from start to end, this is truly a nostalgic snack that diners can’t skip.

name: Lead General Hot Pot
description: In 1980, in Chongqing's Ciqikou, the Shuai family's old stove began crafting a legacy. Master Shuai pioneered the "Three Simmerings and Nine Brewings" beef tallow recipe, paired with the ancestral Nine-Square Grid technique, creating a hotpot known for its rich, layered flavors. The second-generation heir brought this tradition to New York, where the aroma of Chongqing hotpot became a nostalgic symbol for many. Now, he heads to the Lion City, launching "Lead General" hotpot in May 2025, blending century-old techniques with Southeast Asian influences. From Ciqikou to Manhattan, and now to Singapore, "Lead General" aims to share the essence of Chinese hotpot with the world. With a copper pot and a blend of spices, we embark on a journey to let the world savor the timeless flavors of China.

name: Mincheng Bibimbap
description: Mincheng Bibimbap 민정비빔밥 敏丁拌饭 is a renowned establishment specializing in Chinese Korean （中国朝鲜族）ethnic cuisine, offering a unique blend of flavors that reflect the rich culinary heritage of the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture in China. Our menu boasts diverse dishes, with the iconic Mincheng Bibimbap taking center stage. In addition to this signature dish, we offer Stone Plate series and a selection of savory soups inspired by Korean traditions. Complementing these are complimentary offerings like Rice Kimchi and seaweed soup, ensuring a complete and satisfying dining experience.

name: Ministry of Rojak
description: Ministry of Rojak, an expansion of Abdhus Salam Rojak (hailing from Ayer Rajah hawker centre) is dedicated to providing authentic traditional Indian hawker food with an innovative twist without compromising neither its quality nor taste. Its famous sweet potato sauce has a smooth nutty touch that lends a nice texture to the overall sensation and not forgetting a delicious array of Pratas and all the famous mamak gorengs accompanied with its famous hot and cold beverages.

name: Misato
description: A stylish and modern showcase of Japanese gastronomy, Misato offers an elevated dining experience where tradition meets innovation. Enjoy meticulously prepared dishes that capture the essence of Japanese fine dining, served at prices that make exceptional cuisine accessible.

name: Mixue
description: MIXUE is a national chain brand dedicated to creating fresh ice cream and tea for young people. Since establishment in 1997, it has always been adhering to the principle of high quality and affordable price, and committed to promoting better and faster development of the global ice cream and tea industry!

name: Mixue

name: Monster Curry
description: Monster Curry is Singapore’s leading Japanese curry chain restaurant. Be mesmerized by the distinct flavour of the curry sauce, made from fresh fruits and a special blend of spices, resulting in a truly unique Japanese curry. With a spiciness level of your choosing, coupled with a range of assortments on a whopping plate size of 41cm in diameter, no one will leave feeling unfulfilled. The even bigger Japanese combo curry rice options are perfect for sharing. Other items such as Japanese pastas, curry ramen and honey toast are available to round out your meal.

name: Monster Planet
description: Monster Planet is iconic for its gigantic 35cm and 41cm plates, filled with delicious curry made using 14 different types of vegetables and spices, served atop rice or noodles. There are five levels of spiciness, ranging from Normal Spicy to Monster Spicy.

name: Mr Bean
description: Founded in 1995, Mr Bean is the leading chain soya bean food & beverage retailer in Singapore today. With more than 50 stores in Singapore & Asia, Mr Bean offers a variety of soya bean drinks and snacks. Young and old can enjoy refreshing ice blended flavoured soya drinks, ice-creams, pastries and more. Today, Mr Bean prides itself on a strong corporate philosophy of placing customers' interest as their top priority as they continue to emphasize on research to produce healthy and creative products with traditional nutritional values.

description: Founded on 9 April 2017, Nelly's Retro Snacks aims to keep their products at an affordable price and offering the largest and widest variety. They hope that the history of traditional school retro snacks will be enjoyed and appreciated by many generations.

From flame-kissed yakiniku to slow-simmered nitsuke, every bowl features rich flavour & the finest cuts — paired with premium Niigata rice and proprietary sauces. Every meal is a satisfying experience.

Our love for fine tea blends, rich coffee roast and tantalising beverages start our dedication to bringing you an exciting gastronome menu experience. We offer different flavours of tea and coffee beverages from time-honoured traditional drinks to original Old Tea Hut creations, as well as flavourful alternative beverages. So whatever your preference is, we’ll have the right beverage to tantalize your taste buds! We welcome you to discover and enjoy a taste of Old Tea Hut today.

name: Otter Pizza
description: Concept conceived in 2019, Otter Pizza aims to provide a wider variety of quality pizza choices with an affordable price tag to fellow Singaporean in heartland areas. Relying on their expertise in supply chain management and high efficiency achieved from centralized operation, Otter Pizze believe quality can be affordable. Otter Pizza position themselves as a “Neighbourhood Pizzeria” that welcomes repeated visits with family members, friends, couples, and more, throughout their daily lives.

name: Ottie Pancakes
description: Ottie Pancakes brings you the beloved traditional Min Jiang Kueh (MJK ) , also known as Apam Balik, with a delightful modern twist. At Ottie Pancakes, we serve soft, fluffy pancakes in a variety of unique flavors that cater to both traditional and adventurous taste buds. Every bite is crafted to deliver "Sweet Moments in Every Bite", combining nostalgia with a fresh, irresistible twist. Whether you love the classic fillings or are looking to explore new flavours, Ottie Pancakes promises a satisfying treat for everyone!

description: PUTIEN serves cuisine from the Fujian Province in China: characteristically light, down-to-earth, and flavourful food with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. Signatures like Fujian Red Mushroom Seafood Lor Mee, ‘100-Second’ Stewed Yellow Croaker and PUTIEN Bian Rou Soup showcase the culinary richness of Fujianese cuisine that will fill your stomach and heart.

description: PUTIEN MAMA welcomes you with a selection of PUTIEN favourites at everyday locations and prices. Just as mamas are the heartbeat of every family, we care for you with comfort food made from fresh, best-quality ingredients. From savoury, flavourful lor mee to our signature bee hoon made with fine, translucent vermicelli, authentic Heng Hwa recipes are served fresh, hot, and fast with a mama’s touch.

name: Paik's Noodle
description: Bringing you hot favourites such as Jajangmyeon, Jjamppong & Tangsuyuk by South Korean Celebrity Chef Paik Jong Won! Known in its homeland as “Hong Kong Banjeom 0410,” Paik’s Noodle is a culinary hotspot launched in 2006, in Seoul to provide the best flavours, recipes, and sauces by sustaining the real essence of a Korean Chinese restaurant. Paik's Noodle serves a variety of authentic Korean-Chinese dishes like Jjamppong (a hot, flavourful seafood noodle soup), and Paik’s Signature Tangsuyuk (crispy sweet and sour pork) with both being perfect options for sharing with friends or family. Spicy food lovers will love the spice in Jjamppong while kids would love the sweetness and crispness from Tangsuyuk.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 11am to 9pm (8:30pm last order)

name: Papa Ayam
description: Established in 2018 with a food kiosk concept, Papa Ayam deliver the fusion of crispy fried chicken with Indonesian authentic sambal. Ayam (Chicken) and Geprek (Smashed or Crashed) served with traditionally-made original sambal on mortar and pestle that you can choose your spicy level from Level 1 – level 15! Papa Ayam assure you the freshness of the sambal as it is made on the spot according to your spice level. Apart from that, they also serve Sambal Matah (Balinese sambal) and Cabe Ijo (green chilli).

name: Paris Baguette
description: Paris Baguette, born in 1988, is a global bakery brand of SPC Group, a leading South Korean food and confectionery corporation. From its modest beginnings, the chain has grown steadily to become the No.1 bakery in Korea. From 2004, the brand has expanded internationally, the brand operates around 4,000 stores worldwide across the United States, Canada, France, UK, China and Southeast Asia, solidifying its reputation as a truly global premium bakery brand. Paris Baguette is committed to blending traditional baking techniques with modern innovation to deliver diverse range of products such as breads, pastries, cakes, and beverages that appeal to a wide audience, from everyday treats to special celebration.

Making its official debut at West Mall in 2014. Swee Heng 1989 Classic has since gained wide popularity and recognition from Singaporeans. Till date, we have opened a total of 27 outlets and 1 Bakery Cafes island wide. Holding on to the same promise made by Swee Heng Bakery, sharing our baking passion to all communities. description: Tora-San is a Japanese dish concept that serves creative rice bowls garnished with fresh sea products in an authentic and conducive street dining experience. name: Tai Cheong Bakery
description: Tai Cheong Bakery was started in 1954 by egg tart Master Au Yeung’s uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. After taking over Tai Cheong Bakery, Au Yeung pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts, refining several other recipes using techniques he learned from his previous work in a hotel baking cakes. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street. The popularity of Tai Cheong remains till today.

name: Tai Chong Kok
description: At Tai Chong Kok, we have been making mooncakes and traditional Cantonese pastries the same way since 1935 - from scratch and by hand. For 3 generations we have used only premium ingredients to produce our authentic Cantonese confectionary. Tai Chong Kok mooncakes are renowned for their genuine taste of tradition. We are one of the very few bakeries left in Singapore that still produce our fresh lotus paste by hand using 100% pure lotus seeds with no preservatives added and these fill mooncakes that are formed in the same traditional wooden moulds used at the original Sago Street store in Chinatown more than 89 years ago. Today, you can still bring home our mooncakes in stringed brown paper bags, just as our forefathers did in pre-war Singapore. Tai Chong Kok is also famed for our traditional Nian Gao (Chinese New Year's cake) that are made using 100% pure glutinous rice. Tai Chong Kok products are handmade and baked daily with no preservative added in Singapore using time-honoured recipes and quality ingredients with full conformity to Stringent Quality Standards of SFA, HACCP and BizSafe.

description: Established in October 2005, Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites. The enticing aroma of brewed coffee and flavourful local delights infuse vibrancy of life into every store, bringing people together to share in the nostalgic taste of a bygone era. description: The very essence of our brand name, 'EN' representing a gathering place, and 'Biton' meaning beautiful, perfectly captures the soul of our restaurant. We pride ourselves on sourcing the finest pork from renowned farms in Japan and around the world, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavour in every dish. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every cut of pork we serve maintains the highest standards of quality and flavour. Our skilled chefs meticulously prepare each tonkatsu dish to perfection, using airy, light, and crispy panko (bread crumbs) imported from Saitama Prefecture of Japan for that delightful texture. Whether you're indulging in our tonkatsu or exploring our diverse menu of signature dishes like the A4/A5 Miyazaki gyukatsu, black curry ramen, sandos, or a simple take-out bento, expect a culinary journey celebrating the rich and complex flavours of Japanese cuisine

name: Tonkatsu by Ma Maison
description: Ma Maison, which is French for “my house”, is one of the most well-loved restaurant chain offering Western- Japanese fusion cuisine. One of the main draws is its irresistibly good pork cutlet—available as Rosu (pork loin) Katsu or the leaner Hire (pork fillet) Katsu—which undergoes an aging and marinating process before it is breaded and deep-fried. The pork cutlets are served in sets with rice, shredded cabbage, and tonjiru (miso soup with pork) and pickles—all refillable. To enjoy the best of both land and sea, order the premium Unagi Tonkatsu Kamado Set comprising premium charcoal-grilled unagi from Isshiki in Aichi prefecture, kamado- style rice cooked in a traditional Japanese earthen pot, pickles, nyumen (soup noodles) and a choice of Rosu or Hire Katsu.

Experience the fusion of time-honoured flavours and innovative craftsmanship with every visit.

name: Wen Zhang Lao Mian
description: Wen Zhang Lao Mian, a specialist in noodle making and soup development, was established in China in 2017. Over the years, our brand has become well-known. Our goal is to provide a unique dining experience and a comforting atmosphere for all our customers. Among our most beloved noodle dishes are Spicy Beef Noodle, Tomato Soup with Fried Pork, Herbal Soup with Braised Pork, Soup Spicy Fish, and Golden Fish Soup. In addition to noodles, we offer a variety of fried rice, Chinese dishes, and enticing desserts.

name: White Restaurant
description: Welcome to White Restaurant, home to The Original Sembawang White Beehoon – an iconic truly-Singaporean delicacy, alongside renowned dishes like Hainanese Chicken Rice and Chilli Crab. Our founder, Mr Tay, originally crafted this comforting dish, which has since captured the hearts of many. The Original Sembawang White Beehoon stands out with its exceptional flavours and distinctiveness. It has earned its own identity and holds a special place in the hearts of food enthusiasts. While many have tried to imitate our signature dish, none can match its unparalleled taste. That’s why we have rebranded ourselves as White Restaurant, symbolizing the heritage and uniqueness of The Original White Beehoon.

name: Wingstop
description: Serving the World Flavour through an unparalleled guest experience and offering of classic wings, boneless wings and tenders, always cooked to order and hand-sauced-and-tossed in fans’ choice of 10 bold, distinctive flavours, including fans’ favourite Kecap Manis that is exclusive to Singapore. Wingstop’s menu also features signature sides including seasoned fries, hand-breaded mushroom fritters and freshly-made ranch dip.

name: Wok The Fish!

Founded in 2023, we are committed to provide a truly unforgettable dining experience with the use of freshest ingredients. Dive into a world of savory delights at WOK The Fish! and savor the essence of the sea in every spoonful.

name: XW Plus Western Grill
description: Being the western casual dining place, XW Western Grill is your one-stop for all things grilled. Offering a line-up of smoky favourites such as steaks, chicken and fish, the combination of mouth-watering natural juices and charred flavours are perfect for insatiable palates. Our all-you-can-eat salad bar boasting unlimited servings of hot and cold sides won’t disappoint either, it comes free with any main course order or go straight for the à la carte salad bar. Kick back and enjoy western grub in this vibrant value-for-money diner – a perfect avenue for gatherings with family and friends.

name: YAYOI
description: YAYOI is a Japanese Teishoku Restaurant. They serve "Teishoku" which includes a good balance of steamed rice (Japanese staple food), miso soup, main dish, side dish and other items on a tray. YAYOI will pass down Japan's delicious food to the future and spread it to the world.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: Ya Kun Kaya Toast was founded by Mr. Loi Ah Koon, an immigrant from Hainan Island who was 15 when he first set foot on Singapore soil. The business has its humble beginnings at Telok Ayer Basin along Shenton Way in 1944 and the heritage brand with more than 75 years of history now has gained regional and possibly worldwide recognition for its nostalgic local food products, cosy ambience and customer-centric service. The special blend of coffee powder, simple fare of soft-boiled eggs, toast slathered with special homemade kaya and layered with melted butter have had locals and foreigners alike flocking to its outlets. Ya kun continues to spread the love for its signature kaya and aromatic coffee, preserving a cultural heritage and brand that captures the true meaning of ‘The Toast that binds.... Kinship, friendship, partnership’.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 8am to 9pm (Last Order at 8.30pm)

name: umisushi
description: Since 2008, umisushi's Japanese quick-service concept offers delicious and nutritious meals like sushi, sashimi, donburi, bento sets and Japanese salads enjoy by customers of all ages. Currently, umisushi has 15 outlets conveniently located island-wide. We also provide delivery service for you to enjoy a fuss-free meal at the comfort of their home, corporate event and celebration!

name: Big Fish Small Fish
description: Indulge in the freshest seafood experience at Big Fish Small Fish, your ultimate destination for mouth-watering Fish & Chips and an array of delectable fish dishes. Our unique dining concept allows you to personalize your meal to suit your taste buds. At Big Fish Small Fish, we’re committed to serving only the finest, high-quality seafood, meats, and pastas that can be enjoyed exactly as you like it. And, we’re passionate about putting our own creative spin on classic seafood favourites, ensuring every visit is a delightful culinary adventure.

name: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak
description: Boon Lay Power Nasi Lemak is a highly sought after Nasi lemak in Singapore. The best and most tasty Nasi Lemak is a famous traditional Malay recipe that is served hot, just the way you like it.

name: Chocolate Origin & Cacaocat
description: Be it a celebration or to simply fix your chocolate cravings, Chocolate Origin has got you covered. Specialising in chocolate cakes and confectioneries, we use the most finest, quality ingredients to ensure mouth-watering goodness with every bite! Who says you can’t buy happiness? Slowly it gained a loyal following, mostly through word-of-mouth recommendations of a growing fan base. This was undoubtedly due to its commitment to offer only the best chocolate cake that one could find, not just merely within Changi Village, but the whole of Singapore.

name: D'Penyetz
description: Home-grown brand D'Penyetz specialising in Ayam Penyet, offers a variety of items on the menu that features predominantly well-loved Indonesian classics with our signature SMASHED-FRIED CHICKEN & delicious Sambal of various spicy levels.

name: Encik Tan
description: Recognising the demand from the Muslim counterparts for authentic Chinese hawker fare, the Encik Tan brand was introduced as a Halal-certified mini food atrium concept that dishes up a parade of popular local Chinese dishes, such as Hainanese Curry Rice, Wanton Noodles, Ban Mian, and Claypot Rice. All recipes are adapted using Halal ingredients and fine-tuned to deliver the same nostalgic flavour and taste of the original dishes.

description: Geláre is a great place for a perfect meal at anytime of the day. We serve a variety ranging from hot western cuisine and light bites to desserts. Their specialty, freshly baked waffles, is paired with a wide selection of premium ice creams to be enjoyed by all.

description: First ever Korean Oakwood Smoke-Grill barbecue restaurant in Singapore. Nothing is served until it's perfect. A Feast For Your Sense Pleasing to the eyes, Pleasant to smell - All before stepping into a wondrous world of oakwood-grilling.

name: PastaGo
description: Launched in 2022, PastaGo is a takeaway kiosk that serves our very own in-house-made pasta. Different from the usual dried pasta that is commonly found, fresh pasta is silky, smooth, and springy to taste. PastaGo pasta is freshly made from scratch, giving it a silky and velvety texture. Each shape is thoughtfully selected so as to hold the ideal amount of sauce and to provide the best mouthfeel.
opening_hours: Sunday to Thursday 11.30am to 8.30pm Friday & Saturday 11.30am to 9pm

name: Sukiya
description: Sukiya is Japan’s No. 1 quick-service restaurant, which operates more than 2,600 locations across the world. Sukiya specializes in Gyudon – a delicious combination of thinly-sliced tender beef cooked in a soy sauce -based savory sauce with onions all served on top of fluffy, perfectly-cooked Japanese rice.Renowned for its lightning-fast, friendly and energetic-service, Sukiya uplifts and energizes its customers around the world by providing a truly authentic Japanese experience to all.
opening_hours: Monday to Sunday 10am to 10pm daily (Last order: 9.30pm)

name: Super Sushi
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Our commitment to using only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore our innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors—each bite is a testament to our dedication to delight our customers through quality and creativity.

name: The Food Market by Food Junction
description: Step into The Food Market, and one is centred around fresh, raw produce prepared to order, at a variety of cuisine themed stands. The aroma and sounds of cooking, clangs of woks and pans, along with the hustle and bustle of a cultured market place, sets the ambience. The setting of crates, raw display of ingredients, together with an interior of brown and rust hues, further complements the place.
